Cloud and Data Storage: Microsoft Fabric, Azure, ADLS, Azure Data Factory Big Data Technologies: PySpark, Apache Spark, Scala, Hive, Hadoop Architectures and Processes: Lakehouse Architecture, Medallion Architecture, ETL/ELT Orchestration and CI/CD: Airflow, Oozie, Jenkins, Kaniko, Git Other: Azure Service Bus, BFSI, Energy Analytics, Data Quality
raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
Senior Data Engineer Publicis Sapient (RWE – Data Enrichment Platform)
Feb 2025 – Present
As part of the Data Enrichment team, I analyzed, designed, and built end-to-end data flow pipelines for batch applications processing millions of records. Ingested data was received in the Fabric Lakehouse through pipelines, transformed using PySpark, and published as messages to downstream teams via Azure Service Bus. Response messages were then received back through Azure Service Bus and processed to populate the Gold Data Warehouse.
Designed and implemented scalable batch data pipelines using Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse and PySpark. – Integrated PI System source data and delivered curated datasets to the Gold layer. – Built validation frameworks to track record counts across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers. – Optimized Spark jobs and Delta tables for performance, reliability, and scalability. – Developed data quality pipelines to detect and handle null and invalid values in wind turbine datasets. Aug 2021 – Feb 2025
Societe Generale (QURE – Data Quality Framework)
As part of the Development team, I contributed to building a data quality framework called QURE, an in-house solution designed to execute data quality controls on large-scale big data applications. The framework was BCBS 239 compliant, ensuring regulatory-grade data governance and risk reporting. It provided a simple yet effective approach to data quality measurement, where controls were defined and executed using lightweight SQL-based rules, enabling scalability and ease of implementation across data platforms.
Designed and implemented new framework features including deduplication and rule-based validations. – Developed SQL-driven data quality controls to support regulatory and risk reporting requirements. – Built CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Kaniko to deploy Airflow components without Docker hosts. – Developed and maintained Airflow DAGs for data orchestration, notifications, and monitoring. – Resolved production defects and improved overall framework stability and performance. Jun 2016 – Aug 2021
Software Engineer
Tata Consultancy Services (Nordea – Analytics Platform)
– As part of the Development team, I contributed to the development of a data analytics application for financial reporting.
Data was extracted from the master zone of the data lake using Azure Data Factory and processed through multiple downstream models using PySpark APIs. The application provided detailed financial insights consumed through Power BI reports sourced from multiple systems.
Built Spark and Hive-based ingestion and transformation pipelines for financial analytics. – Developed PySpark transformations supporting multiple downstream analytical models. – Optimized Scala-based Spark jobs achieving approximately 35% performance improvement. – Supported Power BI reporting by delivering clean, validated, and analytics-ready datasets.
Software Engineer Tata Projects (Bank of America DCRS(Mainframe))
Skills/Domain: Big Data
Worked in technology unit that supports a collection of content archives that are records (statements, notices, account records and reports). It’s a banking enterprise archive for consumer checking, saving and card statements using XPTR and view direct.
Developed and designed innovative programs as per new requirements. – Made changes in existing code. – Reduced storage and cost to operate for our channel partners and enhanced functionality for customers with improved report retrieval.
